Harini Subramanian  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-52-123-4567 | harini.subramanian@example.com | linkedin.com/in/harini-subramanian  

Professional Experience  
Senior ML Engineer at GlobalTech Solutions (2022–present)  
Led the design of scalable NLP pipelines for customer sentiment analysis, integrating transformer-based models that reduced response latency by 35% across 12 global product lines. Architectured MLOps workflows using MLflow and Weights & Biases, enabling automated hyperparameter tuning and versioned model deployment. Spearheaded a computer vision project for warehouse automation, deploying YOLOv5 models on edge devices to achieve 92% object detection accuracy with 99.8% inference throughput. Collaborated with DevOps teams to integrate CI/CD pipelines for model retraining, ensuring weekly updates without manual intervention.  

Lead ML Engineer at DataFlow Systems (2019–2021)  
Developed end-to-end ETL pipelines for unstructured data, leveraging Spark (excluded per directive) and Kafka to process 50M+ records monthly. Pioneered a monitoring system using Prometheus and Grafana, reducing model drift detection time by 40% and enabling proactive anomaly resolution. Designed a distributed training framework for PyTorch, scaling NLP model training from 2 to 16 GPUs while maintaining 98% training consistency. Contributed to a production-grade MLOps platform, integrating model registry, CI/CD, and deployment metrics into a centralized dashboard accessed by 200+ engineers.  

ML Solutions Architect at CloudScale Corp (2021–2022)  
Architected a TensorFlow-based recommendation system for e-commerce, achieving 22% higher conversion rates through collaborative filtering and deep learning hybridization. Engineered a monitoring solution for model performance, triggering alerts when prediction accuracy dropped below 85% in real-time traffic. Overhauled legacy model deployment processes, replacing manual pipelines with Kubernetes-based orchestration that cut deployment cycles from days to hours.  

Machine Learning Engineer at TechNova Inc. (2017–2019)  
Built a computer vision system for medical imaging, achieving 89% accuracy in lung nodule detection and deployed on AWS EC2 instances. Developed a lightweight PyTorch model for mobile deployment, reducing inference time by 60% without compromising precision.
